originalTitle: US stocks today: Nasdaq, S&P fall over 1%, end lower for week as chip selloff broadens
simplifiedContent: The US stock market had a bad day, with two important groups of stocks, the Nasdaq and S&P, falling by more than 1%. This means that the value of many people's investments went down. The main reason for this was that stocks related to computer chips, which are used in artificial intelligence, continued to lose value, making investors more cautious. Additionally, some companies, like Netflix, predicted weaker future performance, which also hurt investor confidence, even though some banks had reported good earnings. As a result, the market ended the week on a lower note.

originalTitle: Reliance Retail Q1 revenue rises, but profit falls as e-commerce weighs
simplifiedContent: Reliance Retail, a big retail company, had an 8.2% increase in revenue (the total amount of money they made) in the first quarter. However, their profit (the amount of money they made after expenses) decreased by 14.2% because they spent a lot on their e-commerce business. This means that even though they made more money overall, their expenses increased, which reduced their profit. Reliance Consumer, a part of the company, did very well with revenue more than doubling, which is a positive sign. This news matters because it shows how the company is performing and whether their investments in e-commerce are paying off.

originalTitle: JSW Steel’s profit doubles on revenue growth, beats estimates
simplifiedContent: JSW Steel, a steel company, made a lot of money in the quarter from April to June, with its profit reaching Rs 4,696 crore, which is more than double what it made last year. This happened because the company sold more steel and had lower costs for borrowing money. The company's total sales, or revenue, went up by about 10% compared to last year, and its expenses didn't increase as much, which helped its profit grow. This is good news for the company and its investors, as it shows that the company is performing well financially. The company still plans to spend the same amount of money on new projects and investments as it had previously planned.

originalTitle: Beaten down IT majors catch fancy of prop traders
simplifiedContent: Some professional traders have found a way to make a profit from big IT companies whose stock prices have recently fallen. They are borrowing shares from wealthy clients, selling them, and then buying futures contracts for those same IT stocks. This strategy has earned them gains of around 8-9%. This matters because it shows that some traders are still finding ways to make money from these IT stocks, even when their prices are low. It suggests that these traders think the prices of these stocks will go up in the future, which is why they're buying futures contracts.

originalTitle: Netflix shares tumble 13% after weak sales forecast, hit 22-month low
simplifiedContent: Netflix's stock price dropped by 12.6% to its lowest point in 22 months. This happened because the company said it doesn't expect to make as much money as people thought it would, even though its recent financial results were okay. The company is having some problems, such as its original content not doing as well as expected, which is affecting its growth. As a result, Netflix is changing its expectations for how well it will do in 2026. This news is important because it shows that investors are worried about Netflix's future performance, which is why the stock price is going down.

originalTitle: Sebi clears automatic SWP, STP mandates for demat mutual fund holdings
simplifiedContent: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has made a new rule for people who invest in mutual funds through a demat account. Previously, only certain types of mutual fund investments could be set up for automatic transactions, but now this option is available for all demat mutual fund holdings. This means that investors can now set up automatic transfers of money from their mutual funds to their bank accounts or other investments. This change is important because it makes it easier for people to manage their investments and move their money around automatically. This new rule applies to two specific types of automatic transactions: Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) and Systematic Transfer Plan (STP).
